    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    tc.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t

    TopCustomer tc ON t.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY 
    tc.CustomerID, c.Currency;

SELECT (female_clients * 100.0 / total_clients) AS proportion_female
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_clients
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
    WHERE dt.district_id = 123 AND c.gender = 'F'

(
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS total_clients
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
    WHERE dt.district_id = 123
) AS total;

sql:
WITH FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
    ) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT 
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS VARCHAR) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

WITH FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
    ) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT 
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS VARCHAR) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

WITH FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
    ) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT 
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS VARCHAR) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

    ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC

WITH FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
    ) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT 
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS VARCHAR) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

WITH FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
    ) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT 
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS VARCHAR) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

sql:
WITH FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
    ) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT 
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS VARCHAR) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +

    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

WITH FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
    ) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT 
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS VARCHAR) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0

    FROM lapTimes
)

    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

    tc.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t

    TopCustomer tc ON t.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY 
    tc.CustomerID, c.Currency;

WITH FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
    ) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT 
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS VARCHAR) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

sql:
WITH FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
    ) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT 
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS VARCHAR) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        -- Split the time into hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS hours,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2) AS INTEGER) AS milliseconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year,
    AVG((hours * 3600) + (minutes * 60) + seconds + (milliseconds / 1000.0)) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

sql:
WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        -- Split the time into hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS hours,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2) AS INTEGER) AS milliseconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year,
    AVG((hours * 3600) + (minutes * 60) + seconds + (milliseconds / 1000.0)) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        -- Split the time into hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS hours,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2) AS INTEGER) AS milliseconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year,
    AVG((hours * 3600) + (minutes * 60) + seconds + (milliseconds / 1000.0)) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

        b.bond_id,
        b.bond_type,
        a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
        a1.element AS atom1_element,
        a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
        a2.element AS atom2_element,
        CASE 
            WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
            WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
            ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
        END AS bond_classification
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE 
        b.bond_id IN ('TR000_2_4', 'TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_5')
),
molecule_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM 
        molecule m
    JOIN 
        atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    JOIN 
        bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        m.molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE atom_id IN ('TR000_2', 'TR000_4', 'TR000_5', 'TR000_3', 'TR000_1'))
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
)

sql:
WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        -- Split the time into hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS hours,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER)
        END AS seconds,
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 
                0
        END AS milliseconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year,
    AVG((hours * 3600) + (minutes * 60) + seconds + (milliseconds / 1000.0)) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

sql:
WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        -- Split the time into hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS hours,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER)
        END AS seconds,
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 
                0
        END AS milliseconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year,
    AVG((hours * 3600) + (minutes * 60) + seconds + (milliseconds / 1000.0)) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

sql:
WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        -- Split the time into hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS hours,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER)
        END AS seconds,
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 
                0
        END AS milliseconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year,
    AVG((hours * 3600) + (minutes * 60) + seconds + (milliseconds / 1000.0)) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

    bond_type,
    atom1,
    atom2,
    element1,
    element2,
    CASE 
        WHEN element1 = 'cl' OR element2 = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN element1 = 'c' AND element2 = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification
FROM (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        b.bond_type,
        c.atom_id AS atom1,
        c2.atom_id AS atom2,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        connected c2 ON b.bond_id = c2.bond_id AND c.atom_id != c2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c2.atom_id = a2.atom_id
    WHERE 
        b.bond_id IN ('TR000_2_4', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_5')
) AS bond_details;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 0
        END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year, 
    AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CASE 
            WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > LENGTH(REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', '')) 
            THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 0
        END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year, 
    AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

sql:
WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        -- Split the time into hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS hours,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER)
        END AS seconds,
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 
                0
        END AS milliseconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year,
    AVG((hours * 3600) + (minutes * 60) + seconds + (milliseconds / 1000.0)) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        -- Split the time into hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS hours,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER)
        END AS seconds,
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 
                0
        END AS milliseconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year,
    AVG((hours * 3600) + (minutes * 60) + seconds + (milliseconds / 1000.0)) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        -- Split the time into hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS hours,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER)
        END AS seconds,
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 
                0
        END AS milliseconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year,
    AVG((hours * 3600) + (minutes * 60) + seconds + (milliseconds / 1000.0)) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

sql:
SELECT 
    bd.bond_id,
    bd.bond_type,
    bd.atom1,
    bd.atom2,
    bd.element1,
    bd.element2,
    bd.bond_classification,
    m.label AS molecule_label,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        b.bond_type,
        c.atom_id AS atom1,
        c2.atom_id AS atom2,
        a1.element AS element1,
        a2.element AS element2,
        CASE 
            WHEN element1 = 'cl' OR element2 = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
            WHEN element1 = 'c' AND element2 = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
            ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
        END AS bond_classification
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        connected c2 ON b.bond_id = c2.bond_id AND c.atom_id != c2.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c2.atom_id = a2.atom_id
    WHERE 
        b.bond_id IN ('TR000_2_4', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_5')
) AS bd
JOIN 
    molecule m ON bd.bond_id LIKE m.molecule_id || '%'
JOIN 
    atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN 
    bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
GROUP BY 
    bd.bond_id, bd.bond_type, bd.atom1, bd.atom2, bd.element1, bd.element2, bd.bond_classification, m.label;

FROM TimeInSeconds
GROUP BY year;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year, 
        res.time,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CASE 
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN 
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 0
        END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year, 
    AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (

        r.year, 
        res.time,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CASE 
            WHEN LENGTH(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > LENGTH(REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', '')) 
            THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 0
        END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    year, 
    AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

    a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    CASE 
        WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.atom_count,
    m.bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count

        molecule m
    JOIN 
        bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id

WITH member_counts AS (
    SELECT z.state, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member m
    JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
    WHERE m.position = 'Member' AND z.state IN ('New Jersey', 'Vermont')

    ((SELECT member_count FROM member_counts WHERE state = 'New Jersey') / total_member_count * 100.0) - 
    ((SELECT member_count FROM member_counts WHERE state = 'Vermont') / total_member_count * 100.0) AS percentage_difference
FROM total_members;

    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
),
TimeInSeconds AS (
    SELECT year,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END AS total_seconds
    FROM ChampionTimes
)
SELECT year, AVG(total_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM TimeInSeconds
GROUP BY year;

    SELECT year,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END AS total_seconds
    FROM ChampionTimes
)
SELECT year, AVG(total_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM TimeInSeconds
GROUP BY year;

sql:
SELECT year, AVG(total_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM (
    SELECT r.year,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END AS total_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
) AS TimeInSeconds
GROUP BY year;

SELECT year, AVG(total_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM (
    SELECT r.year,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END AS total_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL

sql:
SELECT year, AVG(total_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM (
    SELECT r.year,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END AS total_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
) AS TimeInSeconds
GROUP BY year;

        "Charter School (Y/N)",

FROM HighSchools;

    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975

),

    SELECT year,

                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END AS total_seconds
    FROM ChampionTimes
)
SELECT year, AVG(total_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM TimeInSeconds
GROUP BY year;

    SELECT 
        "School Name",
        "Enrollment (K-12)",
        "Charter School (Y/N)",
        "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
        "District Code"

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS TotalHighSchools,
    AVG("Enrollment (K-12)") AS AverageEnrollment,

    COUNT(DISTINCT "District Code") AS NumberOfDistricts,
    (SELECT "School Name" FROM HighSchools ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 1) AS LargestSchool,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HighPovertySchools
FROM HighSchools;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.time
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
),
TimeInSeconds AS (
    SELECT year,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END AS total_seconds
    FROM ChampionTimes
)
SELECT year, AVG(total_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM TimeInSeconds
GROUP BY year;

SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE 
    c.bond_id IN ('TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_4', 'TR000_2_5');

SELECT r.year,
       AVG(
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
  AND r.year < 1975
  AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;

sql:
SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE 
    c.bond_id IN ('TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_4', 'TR000_2_5');

sql:
SELECT r.year,
       AVG(
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
  AND r.year < 1975
  AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;

sql:
SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE 
    c.bond_id IN ('TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_4', 'TR000_2_5');

sql:
SELECT r.year,
       AVG(
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
  AND r.year < 1975
  AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;

sql:
SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE 
    c.bond_id IN ('TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_4', 'TR000_2_5');

SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE 
    c.bond_id IN ('TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_4', 'TR000_2_5');

SELECT 
    schools."School" AS "School Name",
    schools."Street" || ', ' || schools."City" || ', ' || schools."State" || ' ' || schools."Zip" AS "Location Details",
    schools."MailStreet" || ', ' || schools."MailCity" || ', ' || schools."MailState" || ' ' || schools."MailZip" AS "Unabbreviated Mailing Address",
    schools."Website",
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)",
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
    satscores.NumTstTakr,
    satscores.NumGE1500,
    (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) AS "Percent Scoring >= 1500",
    CASE 
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 70 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) > 20 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 30 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
        ELSE 'Normal performance'
    END AS "Performance Evaluation"
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."School Code" = schools.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm."School Code" = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    schools."Charter" = 0
ORDER BY 
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    AVG(DATE_PART('year', a.date) - DATE_PART('year', c.birth_date)) AS average_age_at_opening,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS total_with_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.account_id END) AS successfully_completed_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN l.account_id END) AS currently_in_debt,
    MIN(DATE_PART('year', a.date)) AS earliest_year,
    MAX(DATE_PART('year', a.date)) AS latest_year
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id IN (554, 2166, 2209, 2965, 3351, 4066, 4302, 4580);

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.time
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
),
TimeInSeconds AS (
    SELECT year,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END AS total_seconds
    FROM ChampionTimes
)
SELECT year, AVG(total_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM TimeInSeconds
GROUP BY year;

    AVG("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS Avg_Free_Meal_Percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Charter_Schools,

        frpm

        "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
        AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
        AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
) AS categorized_schools
GROUP BY Free_Meal_Category
WITH ROLLUP;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.time
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year < 1975
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
),
TimeInSeconds AS (
    SELECT year,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END AS total_seconds
    FROM ChampionTimes
)
SELECT year, AVG(total_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM TimeInSeconds
GROUP BY year;

sql:
SELECT 
    t.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE 
    t.CustomerID = (
        SELECT CustomerID
        FROM (
            SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
            FROM transactions_1k
            GROUP BY CustomerID
            ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC
        ) AS subquery
        LIMIT 1
    )
GROUP BY 
    t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(DATE_PART('year', a.date) - DATE_PART('year', c.birth_date)) AS average_age_at_opening,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS total_with_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.account_id END) AS successfully_completed_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN l.account_id END) AS currently_in_debt,
    MIN(DATE_PART('year', a.date)) AS earliest_year,
    MAX(DATE_PART('year', a.date)) AS latest_year
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id IN (554, 2166, 2209, 2965, 3351, 4066, 4302, 4580);

sql:
SELECT r.year,
       AVG(
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
  AND r.year < 1975
  AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;

                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)

sql:
SELECT 
    schools."School" AS "School Name",
    schools."Street" || ', ' || schools."City" || ', ' || schools."State" || ' ' || schools."Zip" AS "Location Details",
    schools."MailStreet" || ', ' || schools."MailCity" || ', ' || schools."MailState" || ' ' || schools."MailZip" AS "Unabbreviated Mailing Address",
    schools."Website",
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)",
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
    satscores.NumTstTakr,
    satscores.NumGE1500,
    (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) AS "Percent Scoring >= 1500",
    CASE 
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 70 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) > 20 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 30 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
        ELSE 'Normal performance'
    END AS "Performance Evaluation"
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."School Code" = schools.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm."School Code" = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    schools."Charter" = 0
ORDER BY 
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(DATE_PART('year', a.date) - DATE_PART('year', c.birth_date)) AS average_age_at_opening,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS total_with_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.account_id END) AS successfully_completed_loans,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN l.account_id END) AS currently_in_debt,
    MIN(DATE_PART('year', a.date)) AS earliest_year,
    MAX(DATE_PART('year', a.date)) AS latest_year
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id IN (554, 2166, 2209, 2965, 3351, 4066, 4302, 4580);

sql:
SELECT r.year,
       AVG(
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
               ELSE
                   0
           END
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
  AND r.year < 1975
  AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;

sql:
SELECT 
    schools."School" AS "School Name",
    schools."Street" || ', ' || schools."City" || ', ' || schools."State" || ' ' || schools."Zip" AS "Location Details",
    schools."MailStreet" || ', ' || schools."MailCity" || ', ' || schools."MailState" || ' ' || schools."MailZip" AS "Unabbreviated Mailing Address",
    schools."Website",
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)",
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
    satscores.NumTstTakr,
    satscores.NumGE1500,
    (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) AS "Percent Scoring >= 1500",
    CASE 
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 70 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) > 20 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 30 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
        ELSE 'Normal performance'
    END AS "Performance Evaluation"
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."School Code" = schools.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm."School Code" = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    schools."Charter" = 0
ORDER BY 
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

sql:
SELECT 
    t.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE 
    t.CustomerID = (
        SELECT CustomerID
        FROM (
            SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
            FROM transactions_1k
            GROUP BY CustomerID
            ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC
        ) AS subquery
        LIMIT 1
    )
GROUP BY 
    t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

SELECT 
    schools."School" AS "School Name",
    schools."Street" || ', ' || schools."City" || ', ' || schools."State" || ' ' || schools."Zip" AS "Location Details",
    schools."MailStreet" || ', ' || schools."MailCity" || ', ' || schools."MailState" || ' ' || schools."MailZip" AS "Unabbreviated Mailing Address",
    schools."Website",
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)",
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
    satscores.NumTstTakr,
    satscores.NumGE1500,
    (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) AS "Percent Scoring >= 1500",
    CASE 
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 70 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) > 20 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 30 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
        ELSE 'Normal performance'
    END AS "Performance Evaluation"
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."School Code" = schools.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm."School Code" = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    schools."Charter" = 0
ORDER BY 
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;
